external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In addition to two strategic partnerships, the University of Augsburg is part of the Erasmus+ programme. It also maintains numerous international cooperations outside of Erasmus.

Various institutions work together in the Augsburg University Medicine project. The founding dean of the faculty and her team are responsible for setting up the medical faculty. The overall project is accompanied by the Staff Office for Medicine and Strategic Development, which was established by the university management and reports directly to it. Important cooperation partners of the University of Augsburg are the Augsburg University Hospital (Universitätsklinikum Augsburg) and the District H

How can rare tumours – which could be relevant for targeted cancer therapy but may go undetected by conventional tests – be identified? Researchers at Augsburg University Medical Centre are investigating this question. They have now received the Publication Award from the Bavarian Centre for Cancer Research (BZKF) for their paper on this topic.
